origin.description: Area centroid of the rectilinearised OSM footprint of way 73141173 at ground level; z = 0 is the front-door threshold (flat site). World axes are a site grid aligned with the building and Peoples Avenue: +X points along Peoples Avenue toward 14th Street (true bearing 101.10 deg), +Y toward Peoples Avenue (bearing 11.10 deg). Geodetic local ENU metres from origin.latLon: east = 0.98131*x + 0.19245*y, north = -0.19245*x + 0.98131*y.

exterior.reference: Heffner Alumni House, 1301 Peoples Avenue, Troy, NY (RPI)
exterior.method: Approximate massing, not a scan. The OSM footprint (way 73141173) is projected to a local WGS84 tangent plane, rotated by the building's dominant edge bearing so walls and Peoples Avenue align with the world axes, snapped to a rectilinear outline and extruded with heights, wings and roof forms estimated from openly licensed photographs. Street, sidewalk, crossing and footway positions come from OSM centrelines. Flat procedural colours only; no photo pixels or textures.

estimated: All heights. Two above-grade storeys are visible in the photographs (OSM building:levels=3 is not used): ground floor 0.00-3.25 m, upper floor 3.60-6.50 m, flat roofs 6.90 m, parapets 7.80 m.

Subdivision of the OSM footprint into wings (north wing, north-west tower, south gabled block, conservatory, south-west pavilion, east wing) and the positions of their internal boundaries; tower width 5.2 m and conservatory depth 2.71 m.

Roof forms and heights: 50-degree standing-seam gable over the south block (ridge 10.98 m), copper pyramids on the tower (11.2 m) and south-west pavilion (8.2 m), conservatory glass roof 3.0-5.2 m, glass pyramid skylight on the east wing.
Window and door counts, positions and sizes on every facade (rhythm only), facade trim (stone string course, coping, keystones, sills) and all colours.
Front door size (1.0 m x 2.2 m), leaf and surround; only its location comes from the OSM entrance=main node.
Entrance plaza extent, glazed entrance canopy and footway width; the footway centreline is OSM way 1376363931.
Street widths (Peoples Avenue 10.0 m, 14th Street 9.0 m, 13th Street 7.0 m curb to curb), curb height 0.15 m, sidewalk width 1.5 m and verges; centrelines come from OSM.
Flat ground at z = 0 m; the real site slopes down to the west and south.
Tree, shrub, lamp, bench and bin positions and sizes (from photographs, not surveyed); the fire hydrant position is OSM node 12541056051.
Site grid: the footprint is rotated by 11.10 degrees and snapped to a rectilinear outline (maximum vertex shift 0.013 m); street centrelines are snapped to the same grid.
The house region (east part of the footprint) is an authored training interior with authored openings; the rest of the footprint is a sealed volume with decorative windows.
